::: {#fig-prob-odds-log-odds}

$$
\P(A)
\overbrace{
\underbrace{
\underset{\xleftarrow[\frac{\odds}{1 + \odds}]{}}{\xrightarrow{\frac{\P(A)}{1 - \P(A)}}}
\odds
\underset{\xleftarrow[\expf{\logodds}]{}}{\xrightarrow{\logf{\odds}}}
}_{\expitf{\logodds}}
}^{\logitf{\P(A)}}
\logodds
$$

The [probability](#def-probability) $\P(A)$, [odds](#def-odds) $\odds$, and [log-odds](#def-log-odds) $\logodds$ of an [event](#def-event) $A$.
The upper arrows convert each quantity into the next,
and the lower arrows convert back.
Composing the two upper arrows gives the [logit](#def-log-odds), which takes $\P(A)$ to $\logodds$;
composing the two lower arrows gives the
[expit](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-logistic-function),
also called the logistic function, which takes $\logodds$ back to $\P(A)$.

:::
